name: zcode-beautify
description: Set an image or a Wallpaper Engine scene/video as the ZCode desktop background, adapt all UI colors with Material Design 3 (Monet) dynamic color, and tune blur, dim, framing, chat-area masks and wallpaper rotation from a live in-app panel.

description_i18n.en: Set an image or a Wallpaper Engine scene/video as the ZCode desktop background, adapt all UI colors with Material Design 3 (Monet) dynamic color, and tune blur, dim, framing, chat-area masks and wallpaper rotation from a live in-app panel.
description_i18n.zh-CN: 把图片或 Wallpaper Engine 场景/视频设为 ZCode 桌面背景，以 Material Design 3（Monet）动态取色适配全局界面配色，并可在应用内实时面板调节模糊、压暗、取景、聊天区遮罩与壁纸轮播。
